title: tanacetum tabrisianum
intro: Tanacetum tabrisianum, commonly known as Persian tansy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). The plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating digestive issues, relieving stress and anxiety, and acting as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum tabrisianum include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
